<div class="card-body">
'''Corellian''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">コレリア人</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">各ターンに１回、武器／兵器かアイテムを１つ配備コスト－１（最低０）で同じ位置カード上の反乱軍に配備できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Corellian-SWCA-100664.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ブリンディ・トルチョンは典型的なコレリア人女性の密輸屋だ。彼女はモス・アイズリーで、反乱軍に手っ取り早く物資を供給できる手段を探っている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Corellian.

'''Card text:'''
Once each turn, you may deploy one weapon or item on a Rebel at the same location card. Reduce its deploy cost by 1, to a minimum of 0.

'''Lore:'''
Brindy Truchong is a typical Corellian woman who smuggles. In Mos Eisley she is looking for a quick way to supply the Rebellion.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese uses アイテム for device and says location card where the English says site.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Corellian]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
